text:
Rae (Account Exec): FYI - BridgeHealth POC advancing to procurement. They require split invoices for BridgeHealth Inc (US), BridgeHealth EU (IE), and BridgeHealth Labs (UK). Each entity wants its own PO and signer. They also attached a DPA redline requesting HSM for hosted and a 48h breach notification. Can we support multi-entity invoices + delegated signers?

procurement_bridge: Hi team - AP delegates will sign for speed. Also need VAT handling for the EU entity and separate remit addresses. Can you confirm invoice PDF per entity?

Noah (Legal): Delegated AP signers are acceptable with a short attestation (name, role, confirmation of authority). HSM for hosted is an escalation; our default: HSM only for Private/Dedicated. We'll propose: KMS attestation + SOC2 reports for Hosted. 48h notification is aggressive; propose reasonable efforts and a confirmation window (72h) after incident validation. Also flag: their DPA tries to shorten data deletion timelines to 30 days which conflicts with our backup retention; counter with 90 days + documented purge process.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Technically fine to support per-entity metadata and signer routing. Suggested order form snippet: 
```
billing_entity: bridge-eu-llc
po_number: BH-EU-0426
vat_number: IE1234567V
signer: "Liam O'Connor <liam@bridgehealth.ie>"
```
Fallback: if signer missing, route to parent finance alias. I'll prepare sample OF JSON and invoice schema.

Ethan (Finance): Separate PDFs per legal entity required for tax reporting. Need tax IDs and remit addresses before first invoice. Net terms: procurement asked net30; finance can approve pending credit check. If credit not approved, request prepay or CC on file.

Marta (Security): On HSM, we can provide attestation and KMS architecture diagrams for Hosted. If they insist on HSM custody, recommend Private deployment (adds cost). I'll attach the KMS whitepaper and pen-test summary upon request. Also confirm we do not support key export on Hosted.

Rae (Account Exec): Procurement - please share tax IDs, remit addresses, and confirm AP signer names + titles. We'll need the DPA redline to route to Legal.

procurement_bridge: We'll send redlines and tax IDs today. Quick Q: for liability cap, they propose 12-month fees. Would you accept a floor?

Noah (Legal): We'll counter with liability cap = fees paid in the prior 12 months or $200k floor, whichever is greater. Also include signatory attestation language for AP delegates.

Ethan (Finance): Confirming invoice workflow: one invoice PDF per entity, distinct invoice numbers, separate remit-to, and VAT handling per entity. Provide PO -> entity mapping before first invoice.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll post the OF payload sample and invoice mapping later today.

Rae (Account Exec): Thanks everyone — I'll collect the docs and post back when procurement responds. :white_check_mark:
